summary: Iteration 7 testing complete for the 4 new features + regression. (1) Provider hours: POST /api/admin/providers with hours object persists correctly; GET /api/providers/{id} returns identical hours (mon 08:00-20:00, sun closed:true). Provider without hours has hours=null/absent. (2) Open-now badge: on /directory, TEST_ITER7_WithHours (today set 00:00-23:59) shows [data-testid=open-badge-0]='Open now'; TEST_ITER7_NoHours has NO open-badge element. Provider detail /provider/{id} renders [data-testid=provider-hours] listing all 7 days (Mon-Sun) with status text; without hours the card is NOT rendered. (3) Featured articles: created plain + featured articles, GET /api/articles returns featured first (order verified via list index). /blog shows [data-testid^=article-featured-] gold '★ Featured' badge, and featured article renders before the plain one (idx 0 vs idx 1). (4) Favicons: /favicon.ico, /favicon.png, /apple-touch-icon.png, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png all 200; index.html references favicon.ico + apple-touch-icon; manifest.json still lists icon-192 & icon-512. Backend regression: 13/13 pytest passed (auth, providers list, reviews list, provider CRUD, article CRUD). Seed test data (2 providers + 2 articles) created and cleaned up — verified count of TEST_ITER7 providers = 0 after cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: hours.js openStatus overnight support (c<=o wrap) is nice, but hasHours() requires AT LEAST one day with open&close and not closed to consider hours 'known'. If admin sets ALL 7 days closed, hasHours returns false and no badge is shown at all (rather than 'Closed today'). Minor UX; not a bug.
HoursEditor: default fill of 09:00-17:00 applied on first edit of a day may not be intuitive if admin wanted a completely empty schedule. Acceptable.

ProviderCard open-badge relies on browser LOCAL time — correct for user, but be aware that Caribbean providers viewed from a very different timezone will see badges reflecting the viewer's clock, not the provider's local time. Not fixed in current release; document if needed.

server.py list_articles sort ('featured', -1) works, but older articles missing the 'featured' field sort as if featured=null which Mongo treats consistently — verified featured=true appears first. Fine.
AdminDashboard.jsx still large (~650+ lines) — split by tab (Providers/Articles/Events) when convenient (repeat comment from iter6).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ITER7_Hours, TEST_ITER7_NoHours, TEST_ITER7_WithHours providers and TEST_ITER7_Plain + TEST_ITER7_Featured articles via /api/admin/* endpoints. All deleted post-test — verified TEST_ITER7 provider count = 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Provider hours object shape: {mon:{open:'08:00',close:'17:00',closed:false}, ...}. Set today's key to 00:00-23:59 to force 'Open now' badge. Featured article badge testid is article-featured-<i> where <i> is card index. GET /api/articles already applies featured-first sort backend-side, so frontend just renders in order. When testing, remember to source REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env before running pytest (else requests fails with MissingSchema).
